dogecoin.text:
@elonmusk Damnit @elonmusk. Stop with Bitcoin and Dogecoin. They do not and cannot scale appropriately because of their fundamental problems (primarily PoW consensus), and really can't even be upgraded.

PLEASE take a serious look at $NANO and it's wholesomely memeified cousin $BAN.
@CEOAdam You've seriously got to consider real projects like $NANO and $ADA before Dogecoin.
@gladstein Oh, and no, dogecoin is not one of them. Though I think we do have to acknowledge the impact that it and similar memecoins have had on spreading overall awareness of crypto.
